description: Sign an artifact with an Ed25519 receipt. Returns the receipt JSON: artifact hash, agent, task, amount and a signature anyone can verify offline.

artifact_b64.description: the delivered file's bytes, base64 — use this with a hosted endpoint

artifact_name.description: optional filename recorded in the receipt

artifact_path.description: path to the delivered file (local/stdio only; a hosted server refuses it)

artifact_text.description: the delivered content as UTF-8 text, when it is text

key_path.description: optional Ed25519 private key file (local/stdio only); a fresh key is used otherwise

name: issue_receipt
